verdict.line: You lose if he pins you behind his W wall and lets Mist Walkers swarm; you win if you open with Q's stun and finish with R before he closes.

brief.thesis: Yorick wants a long, trapped fight: his passive Mist Walkers swarm nearby enemies and his E (Mourning Mist) mark makes them move faster toward whoever it hits, so once his W (Dark Procession) wall seals the exit he wins extended melee — which is exactly why OP.GG flags the solo-kill edge as his. Sion's answer isn't to out-trade him in that extended fight, it's to never let it start: Q (Cryptic Gaze) stuns from 550 range to open or punish, and R (Cannibalism) at level 6 turns a committed all-in into a lifesteal-and-attack-speed win. The 55.2% head-to-head over 87 games against a 49.6% overall baseline says this reads correctly in practice.

theirWindow.when: after he pins you with the W wall
theirWindow.what: Once the wall is up and you're on his side of it, his passive Mist Walkers close in and his E mark speeds them up further — you cannot out-sustain that in melee. Trade Q and leave before the wall lands, don't stand and brawl.

yourWindow.what: R gives you lifesteal on every attack plus attack speed for the fight — this is your actual win condition in an all-in. Open with Q's stun, toggle E (Enrage) on, pop R, and commit; he has no answer to sustained attack speed plus lifesteal in a short fight.

start.why: 53.9% win rate over 76 games and the 64.4% pick for a reason — the extra regen and poke-block directly answers his Q (Last Rites) empowered auto and E (Mourning Mist) poke while you farm up to level 6.

boots.why: 57.5% win rate over 87 games. He's an auto-attack-reliant melee champion once his Mist Walkers swarm, and flat damage reduction against a stack of small attacks outvalues Swiftness here.

core.why: Stacks max health from every proc, which compounds directly with Enrage's (E) permanent HP-on-kill — you become harder to burst down in exactly the extended fights he wants.
The shield-on-low-health layer lets you survive the window where he's dumped his E mark and Mist Walkers are already on you, buying time to land Q.
Converts your stacking max HP into flat damage on every hit, so the tankier you get from Heartsteel and Enrage, the harder your own trades hit back.

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.1% win rate on this page. Every proc stacks permanent max health, which layers on top of Enrage's (E) own permanent HP-on-kill — you're building toward the same unkillable late-game off two separate sources.

summoners.why: 54.1% win rate at an 82.4% pick rate. Flash gets you out from behind his W wall before Mist Walkers close the gap, and Teleport lets you keep pushing your late-game HP stacking advantage across the map once you've out-scaled him.

playing.title: Open every trade with Q
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze stuns from 550 range — land it before he can throw out E (Mourning Mist) to mark you and speed his Mist Walkers toward you. On a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown, don't waste it on minions early.

playing.title: Never fight inside his W wall
playing.detail: Dark Procession seals an area off — once you're on his side of it, his passive Mist Walkers swarm and you have no exit. Trade and disengage before it lands, especially from level 3 onward.

playing.title: Toggle Enrage only when committing
playing.detail: E gives AD at the cost of health per attack with zero cooldown — leave it off while last-hitting and only flip it on for a trade you intend to win, since it's bleeding your HP the whole time it's active.

playing.title: Save Cannibalism for the all-in
playing.detail: R is on a 90s cooldown and gives lifesteal plus attack speed in close combat — this is your actual answer to his melee advantage. Don't burn it poking; pop it only when you're committing to kill.

playing.title: Shield-tank his poke, then detonate
playing.detail: Death's Caress (W) absorbs incoming damage on an 8s cooldown — use it to eat his empowered Last Rites auto or E mark, then reactivate it early to blast surrounding enemies back.

playing.title: Look to punish before level 6
playing.detail: His kit spikes hardest once the W wall and walker swarm come online around level 3-5; your own spike is R at level 6. Play for short trades and avoid getting boxed in during that window.

playing.title: Buy grievous wounds if he's healing
playing.detail: Last Rites (Q) heals him on every empowered auto — if that sustain is winning him trades, Bramble Vest early or Thornmail later cuts it outright.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and the win-rate numbers above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the power-curve timing, trade patterns, and the reasoning behind each choice are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being trapped inside (E) after reaching level 3. Yorick has the upper hand in melee combat so focus on clearing minions from a safe distance.
